title: 31 December 1960: Live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
content:
The Beatles ended 1960 with a performance at the Casbah Coffee Club in Hayman’s Green, owned by drummer Pete Best’s mother Mona.

This was the fourth and final time The Beatles played with stand-in bassist Chas Newby, following Stuart Sutcliffe’s decision to stay in Germany with Astrid Kirchherr.

The Beatles played at the Casbah Coffee Club a total of 37 times between 1960 and 1962. The other dates were: 17 December 1960; 15 and 29 January; 12, 19 and 26 February; 5, 12, 19 and 26 March; 6, 13 and 27 August; 10 and 24 September; 22 October; 19 and 24 November; 3 and 17 December 1961; 7, 14, 21 and 28 January; 4, 11, 18 and 25 February; 4, 11, 18 and 25 March; 1, 7 and 8 April; and 24 June 1962.

The Quarrymen also performed at the Casbah on seven occasions: 29 August; 5, 12, 19 and 26 September; and 3 and 10 October 1959.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1966: George Harrison is refused entry to Annabel’s nightclub in London
  • 1965: The Beatles attend New Year’s Eve parties
  • 1964: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
  • 1963: Live: The Beatles’ Christmas Show
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Star-Club, Hamburg
  • 1962: Heather McCartney is born
